A form of '''armor''' with flat-topped helmet and lamellar warskirt was used by the early [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was considered an antique.

==Characteristics==
It consisted of a segmented torso [[Armor/Legends|armor]] shaped like a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] rib cage. Square, rigid-looking [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] covered the shoulders, the armpits, and part of the back. A flat-topped, visorless war helmet protected the head with a large, heart-shaped opening. A protective skirt of blade-shaped strips was worn around the waist.<ref name="STOR" />

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], many of those ancient suits of armor were still on display in the tombs of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. When they were still an apprentice, the [[Empire's Wrath]] found one such armor in the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]]. It lay in a [[Sith sarcophagus]] along with an ancient [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], still containing the corpse of a [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Tomb of Naga Sadow)|long-dead Sith Lord]]. Another was stored amongst other artifacts in [[Darth Thanaton]]'s [[Darth Thanaton's private library|private library]].<ref name="STOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The look of this armor was probably based on that of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who first appeared in [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]] in [[1994]]. It features the same type of flat-topped headdress and a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pteruges protective skirt] reminiscent of military officers of the [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ancient_Rome ancient Rome].
